steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We've broken through Reunion's encirclement!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: But... they...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: ... I... Aaaagh...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Shh...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...Don't let Amiya hear you.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Amiya's kept a clear head through this! She's a lot more mature than we thought...!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Even if that's the case, we can't let her hear this!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We mustn't burden her any further. She's already... carrying the weight of the world on her shoulders.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...We can't... let their efforts go to waste!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: They made the ultimate choice to let us live, so we have to return the favor... by making sure Amiya and the Doctor return safely.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Now isn't the time to be dejected.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: As the Radiant Knight, shouldn't you always be our beacon of hope, no matter what happens?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: ... I'm not sure anymore. But, I will do my part.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Regroup! Don't let your guard down! We're almost there!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Those who told me not to worry... None of them ended up coming back.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor {@nickname}...? What happened...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: P-please... let me down...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mm, I'm fine. I can walk on my own...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I just... lost consciousness for a little... but I'm okay.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...We managed to make it out?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What about Ace and the others...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's okay. I'm sure Ace will be fine.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everyone in Rhodes Island is very strong.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're almost at the south exit. Once we leave Chernobog, we'll be...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We'll... be...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... Can I... lean on you for a bit...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Just... a little...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: What a pain.

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: How did that guy... manage to do this...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: Half of the city was burnt to ashes, the entire plaza became a sea of flames... Steel was melting and reforming...

steps.name: Mephisto
steps.text: But how was he... able to keep fighting?
He fought until the bitter end... Impressive.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'll remember this.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...Rhodes Island.
